depsrepair.kind.prune.label: Prune
depsrepair.kind.prune.explain: remove the installed packages or requirements that nothing declares or uses. The plan of each tool says what else it changes.
depsrepair.kind.reinstall.label: Clean reinstall
depsrepair.kind.reinstall.explain: delete the installed dependencies, then install them again. A lockfile keeps the versions.
depsrepair.kind.lockfile.label: Rebuild the lockfile
depsrepair.kind.lockfile.explain: delete the lockfile (and the installed dependencies), then resolve again. The versions can change.
depsrepair.kind.cache.label: Clear the download cache
depsrepair.kind.cache.explain: clear the download cache of the tool, then install. Other workspaces on this machine use the same cache.
depsrepair.kind.none: no tool of this workspace has it
depsrepair.warn.machine_wide: This clears a cache that every workspace on this machine uses: they download their packages again.
depsrepair.warn.machine_wide.remedy: to repair this workspace only, choose a lighter repair
depsrepair.warn.versions: The versions can change: a manifest or a lockfile is written again.
depsrepair.warn.versions.remedy: review the diff before you commit it. smith does not commit it
